mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have overcast skies and 34 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, with a wind chill making it feel like 27. The International Space Station passes overhead tonight, though overcast conditions will block visibility.

Property tax bills will be mailed to City of Verona residents no later than December 15th. Payments can be split into two installments, with the first due January 31st to the City Treasurer. Options to pay include online payments, mail, or using the 24-hour drop boxes at the City Center.

Local events kick off today with trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow features Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, yoga at Insight Wellness, and live music at Paddy Mac's. Later this week, check out the 50 Years of Craft Brewing celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In police news, on Friday, November 6th, officers and fire personnel responded to a report of a passed-out driver in a vehicle on West Verona Avenue, resulting in the arrest of a 31-year-old Mount Horeb woman for O W I.
Culver's is open today until 10:00 PM, featuring OREO REESE'S Cheesecake as the flavor of the day. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate Decadence.
